## Agent Responsibilities

The following agents are expected to contribute to this feature:

| Agent | Responsibility |
|-------|---------------|
| 🧑‍💻 **Developer** | Implement the feature in `web-apps/` |
| 📝 **Doc-Writer** | Update `README.md` and `docs/` with relevant documentation |
| 📡 **Telemetry-Engineer** | Add or update OpenTelemetry instrumentation |
| 🔒 **Security-Engineer** | Review changes for security issues |
| ⚙️ **Automation-Engineer** | Keep VS Code tasks, devcontainer, and scripts in sync |
| 🧪 **Test-Engineer** | Add unit tests to `web-app-tests/` |
| 🗄️ **Data-Engineer** | Provide any required sample/seed data |
| 👔 **Dev-Manager** | Review all agent contributions for quality |
